name: link-mobile
description: Link mobile app — faithful Capacitor/Android port of KDE Connect's protocol

scripts.build:android: npx cap copy android && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:Path+=';C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat clean assembleRelease; cd ..; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ..\..\rodix\public\installers; Copy-Item -Path android\app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk -Destination ..\..\rodix\public\installers\link.apk -Force"
scripts.ship:android: npm run build:android && npm run install:android
